name: Passive Recon (OSINT Only)
description: Passive reconnaissance using OSINT sources only. No active scanning. For authorized bug bounty targets within declared scope.
author: PortableLM

steps.prompt:
You are a bug bounty recon specialist. For the authorized target domain: {{input}}

Generate a complete passive recon methodology covering:
1) DNS enumeration via passive sources (crt.sh, SecurityTrails, DNSDumpster)
2) Google dork queries for the domain (site:, filetype:, inurl:, intitle:)
3) GitHub/GitLab exposure search queries
4) Shodan/Censys search queries
5) Wayback Machine/archive.org URL discovery approach
6) ASN and IP range lookup approach
7) Technology fingerprinting via passive means (BuiltWith, Wappalyzer)
8) Email/employee enumeration via OSINT (LinkedIn, Hunter.io patterns)

IMPORTANT: Passive/OSINT only. No active scanning, no direct requests to target.

Analyse these certificate transparency results for {{input}}:
{{cert_data}}

Extract:
1) All unique subdomains
2) Interesting service/app names suggesting attack surface
3) Wildcard certificate scopes
4) Historical domains and expired certs (potential subdomain takeover candidates)
5) Third-party services in use (CDN, mail, auth providers)
6) Prioritised targets to investigate further within bug bounty scope
